1 Scientific Literature.Authors: Fady M. A. Hassouna, Yeon Woo Jung
1 Scientific Literature.Journal_or_Source: Advances in Civil Engineering, Vol. 2020, Article ID 8822994
1 Scientific Literature.Study_Objective: Develop a pavement concrete with higher flexural strength using steel slag as SCM (20% of cementitious) plus hooked-end steel fibers, to reduce rigid pavement thickness.
1 Scientific Literature.Abstract_or_Key_Finding: 20% steel slag with 1.0-1.5% steel fibers raised 28 d flexural strength by 48.9-50.5% vs reference (max 9.7 MPa), allowing >24-30% thinner pavement. Slag improved flexural strength of fiber concrete by 3.3-15.9% but reduced slump.
1 Scientific Literature.Notes: Slag type not specified ("produced in a steel factory as a result of burning the iron ore"). Slag contents 10/20/30% trialled; 20% chosen, only 20% results reported.
